invention.ref: Hog-bristle toothbrush used in Tang-dynasty China (619–907)
invention.ref_zh: 唐代（619–907）中国已使用猪鬃牙刷

mass_production.ref: William Addis makes the first mass-produced toothbrush in England
mass_production.ref_zh: 英国的阿迪斯制作首批量产牙刷

notes: 更早的嚼枝（chew stick）可追溯到约前 3500 年的苏美尔，但不属于刷毛牙刷。阿迪斯的具体城市未核实，地点只到国家。
summary_zh: 把猪鬃装在骨柄上的牙刷在唐代中国已经使用，17 世纪传入欧洲；1780 年英国的威廉·阿迪斯开始量产牙刷。
summary_en: Bristle toothbrushes were used in Tang-dynasty China and reached Europe in the 17th century; William Addis began mass-producing them in England around 1780.
notes_en: Chew sticks go back to Sumer around 3500 BCE but are not bristle brushes. Addis's city is unverified, so the location is country-level.
